rule1.problem: The CPU does not fit the motherboard's socket. Choose a CPU and a motherboard of the same socket.
rule1.unchecked: Whether the CPU fits the motherboard's socket could not be checked. Check both sockets before you buy.

rule2.problem: The CPU cooler does not fit the CPU's socket. Choose a cooler that lists the CPU's socket.
rule2.unchecked: Whether the CPU cooler fits the CPU's socket could not be checked. Check the cooler's box before you buy.

rule3.problem: The CPU does not support the RAM's type. Choose RAM of a type the CPU supports.
rule3.unchecked: Whether the CPU supports the RAM's type could not be checked. Check the CPU's memory types before you buy.

rule4.problem: The RAM's type does not fit the motherboard. Choose RAM of the motherboard's type.
rule4.unchecked: Whether the RAM's type fits the motherboard could not be checked. Check the motherboard's memory type before you buy.

rule5.problem: The RAM kits have more sticks than the motherboard has slots. Remove a kit, or choose a motherboard with more slots.
rule5.unchecked: Whether the motherboard has a slot for every RAM stick could not be checked. Check the motherboard's memory slots before you buy.

rule6.problem: The RAM adds up to more than the motherboard can take. Choose less RAM, or a motherboard that takes more.
rule6.unchecked: Whether the motherboard can take all the RAM could not be checked. Check how much memory the motherboard takes before you buy.

rule7.problem: The case does not take the motherboard's form factor. Choose a case that takes it, or a motherboard the case takes.
rule7.unchecked: Whether the case takes the motherboard's form factor could not be checked. Check the case's box before you buy.

rule8.problem: The motherboard has no PCIe slot of {lanes} lanes for the GPU. Choose a motherboard with one.
rule8.unchecked: Whether the motherboard has a PCIe slot of {lanes} lanes for the GPU could not be checked. Check the motherboard's slots before you buy.

rule9.problem: The GPU is longer than the case allows. Choose a shorter GPU, or a case with room for a longer one.
rule9.unchecked: Whether the GPU fits the case's length could not be checked. Check both lengths before you buy.

rule10.problem: The GPU takes more slots than the case has. Choose a slimmer GPU, or a case with more expansion slots.
rule10.unchecked: Whether the case has enough slots for the GPU could not be checked. Check the case's expansion slots before you buy.

rule11.problem: The PSU lacks the power connectors the GPU needs. Choose a PSU with the GPU's power connectors.
rule11.warning: The PSU lacks the GPU's power cable, but has the connectors its adapter takes. Use the adapter that comes with the GPU.
rule11.unchecked: Whether the PSU can power the GPU could not be checked. Check both Parts' power connectors before you buy.

rule12.problem: The PSU's wattage leaves too little to spare over the Build's estimated power draw. Choose a PSU of more watts.
rule12.unchecked: Whether the PSU is strong enough for the Build could not be checked. Check its wattage against the CPU's and the GPU's before you buy.

rule13.problem: The SATA drives outnumber the motherboard's SATA ports. Remove a SATA drive, or choose a motherboard with more ports.
rule13.unchecked: Whether the motherboard has a SATA port for every SATA drive could not be checked. Check the motherboard's ports before you buy.

rule14.problem: The M.2 drives outnumber the motherboard's M.2 slots. Remove an M.2 drive, or choose a motherboard with more slots.
rule14.unchecked: Whether the motherboard has an M.2 slot for every M.2 drive could not be checked. Check the motherboard's slots before you buy.

rule15.problem: The drives outnumber the case's drive bays. Remove a drive, or choose a case with more bays.
rule15.warning: The case lists no drive bay for the {inches}-inch drives. Many small cases mount them elsewhere; the case's manual says.
rule15.unchecked: Whether the case has a bay for every drive could not be checked. Check the case's drive bays before you buy.

rule16.problem: The SATA drives outnumber the PSU's SATA power connectors. Remove a SATA drive, or choose a PSU with more connectors.
rule16.unchecked: Whether the PSU has a SATA power connector for every SATA drive could not be checked. Check the PSU's connectors before you buy.

rule17.problem: The CPU cooler is taller than the case allows. Choose a lower cooler, or a case with more room above the CPU.
rule17.unchecked: Whether the CPU cooler fits the case's height could not be checked. Check both heights before you buy.

rule18.problem: The case does not take the PSU's form factor. Choose a PSU the case takes, or a case that takes it.
rule18.unchecked: Whether the case takes the PSU's form factor could not be checked. Check the case's box before you buy.

rule19.problem: The PSU is longer than the case allows. Choose a shorter PSU, or a case with room for a longer one.
rule19.unchecked: Whether the PSU fits the case's length could not be checked. Check both lengths before you buy.

rule20.problem: The PSU has no CPU power connector for the motherboard. Choose a PSU with one.
rule20.warning: The PSU has fewer CPU power connectors than the motherboard has sockets. Many motherboards start with one; the motherboard's manual says.
rule20.unchecked: Whether the PSU has the motherboard's CPU power connectors could not be checked. Check both before you buy.

rule21.problem: The motherboard's connectors face its back, and the case does not take such a motherboard. Choose a case that does, or another motherboard.
rule21.unchecked: Whether the case takes the motherboard's rear connectors could not be checked. Check the case's box before you buy.
